ruleDefinitions.name: Disable Macro Runtime Scan Scope
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects tampering with the MacroRuntimeScanScope registry key to disable runtime scanning of enabled macros Note: Unmapped fields: Details

sequences.query: ((registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\SOFTWARE\\\\.*") AND registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\Microsoft\\\\Office\\\\.*") AND registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\Common\\\\Security.*")) AND registry_path = RGX("\\\\MacroRuntimeScanScope$") AND Details = "DWORD\ \(0x00000000\)")
